research_notes: The final operating cap should ideally be validated under a workload profile close to actual expected production, with stress profiles used to define safety margin.
A universal cap based solely on an unusually heavy diagnostic profile may be unnecessarily conservative.
Conversely ignoring the stress profile entirely could understate worst-case risk.
The promotion rule should balance representative operation and worst-case evidence explicitly.
Current coarse ascent does not need to settle that balance yet.
It only locates the runtime region.
